summary.name: Plone
summary.one_liner: Plone is an open-source content management system built on Python and React, usable as a traditional CMS or as a headless CMS with a REST API.
use_cases: building a website with a Python-based CMS
running a self-hosted content management system
serving content through a REST API to a custom frontend
managing editorial content with a user-friendly interface
summary.what_it_does: Plone is an open-source CMS built on Python and React. It has a modern React frontend for editors and a Python backend. It provides a REST API so developers can run it as a headless CMS and build a custom frontend with their own technology. The page says it can be run fully on premises or in the cloud, and that the full software stack is open source and backed by a foundation. The page describes Plone 6.2 as the latest release.
notable: Headless CMS mode with a REST API for custom frontends
React frontend with a Python backend
Runs on premises or in the cloud
Backed by an open source foundation
caveats: Page does not state specific pricing details beyond the software being open source
Page does not describe hosting or support costs
